# Getanchor — Style Reference

> Unbleached bid-ledger paper with one ember-orange pressure point. Regular-weight Archivo grotesk set tight on #fbfbf9 stock, sand panels stacked by tone instead of shadow, 4px corners, and orange spent only on the act-now button.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Getanchor speaks a warm-ledger product language. An unbleached #fbfbf9 canvas carries stacked sand panels in #f5f2f0 and #f0eae5. Pure #ffffff is reserved for product mockups. Ink #1e1e1e is used 95 times as text and fill, and it flips into an inverted footer. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue: Ember Signal #ee884f, with two measured uses, permitted only on the primary CTA fill and on a single status dot. Periwinkle and sage washes sit behind product screenshots as decorative backdrops. Typography is one family, Archivo, and 153 of its 175 measured instances are weight 400. Hierarchy comes from four sources: size, a jump from 18px body straight to 36px headings, -0.03em tracking at every display size, and a two-tone split where an ink line hands off to a #777777 grey line. Buttons hold 4px corners and panels 6px. Elevation is a four-layer shadow that peaks at 6% black. The result reads as a procurement document typeset by a careful editor rather than a SaaS landing page shouting for clicks.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#fbfbf9` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background, hero field and the gutters between feature tabs. It is a 1% warm off-white, so the page reads as stock paper rather than screen glare. |
| Chalk White | `#ffffff` | `--color-chalk-white` | Product mockup windows, the consent panel and file-row cards inside gradient stages. It is the brightest value, so it is rationed to "this is the software" moments. |
| Linen Panel | `#f5f2f0` | `--color-linen-panel` | Inactive feature tab cells and secondary panel fills, with 17 uses as the most frequent background. It is the workhorse surface, one step above the canvas. |
| Stone Panel | `#efeeec` | `--color-stone-panel` | Integration-diagram stages and nav button resting fills, with 9 uses. It is the cool-neutral sibling of the sand panels and keeps diagrams from tinting warm. |
| Sand Panel | `#f0eae5` | `--color-sand-panel` | Feature showcase panels and the active tab cell that merges into them, with 9 uses. It is the warmest surface and marks "content lives here" without a border. |
| Clay Tab | `#e3d7cd` | `--color-clay-tab` | Hover state on feature tabs and pressed section-index rows, with 3 uses. It is the darkest sand step and signals interaction purely through value. Do not use it as a panel fill. |
| Frosted Nav | `#fbfbf9d9` | `--color-frosted-nav` | Sticky navigation bar fill at 85% opacity over scrolled content. It is a glass surface that keeps the canvas tone while content slides underneath. |
| Ink | `#1e1e1e` | `--color-ink` | Headlines, body, secondary button fill and the footer surface, with 81 text uses and 14 fill uses. It is a softened black that keeps contrast high without harshness. |
| Pewter Caption | `#777777` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Second line of two-tone headings, "Learn more" links and section-index labels (estimated). It is the system's hierarchy lever and does the job bold weight does elsewhere. |
| Cream Ink | `#f0e9e5` | `--color-cream-ink` | Footer links and headings on Ink, plus secondary-button labels, with 29 uses. It is warm cream text that keeps the inverted footer in the paper family. |
| Quartz Track | `#d0d5d2` | `--color-quartz-track` | Toggle switch tracks, with 5 uses. It is a cool grey-green hairline tone for inactive controls. Do not use it as body text or as a border on sand panels. |
| Ember Signal | `#ee884f` | `--color-ember-signal` | Primary CTA fill and the "Searching sources" status dot, with 2 uses. It is the only saturated system hue. Do not spread it to backgrounds, icons or headline highlights. |
| Periwinkle Wash | `#9da5c7` | `--color-periwinkle-wash` | Grainy gradient backdrop behind the generation mockup, with 1 use. It is decorative staging only and is not to be used as a text, button or border color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Archivo — one regular-weight grotesk carrying every role from micro-label to display · `--font-archivo`

- **Substitute:** Archivo at 400 (it is open-source on Google Fonts, so use it directly whenever possible). Inter at 400: it draws slightly wider and a touch darker, so do not step up to 500. Public Sans at 400. Archivo renders true to its nominal weight, so a measured 400 looks like a 400. Match number for number and avoid any 300 substitute, which will read visibly thin at 68px.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px, 36px, 44px, 52px, 68px
- **Line height:** 0.9 at 68px, 1.0 at 52px and 44px, 1.1 at 36px, 1.3 at 18px and 16px, 1.5 at 15px, 1.2 at 14px, 1.4 at 11px
- **Letter spacing:** -2.04px at 68px, -1.56px at 52px, -1.32px at 44px, -1.08px at 36px, -0.14px at 14px, normal at 15px/16px/18px, +0.66px at 11px uppercase
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 68px is the signature. Headlines are massive and quiet, and 87% of all type on the page sits at regular weight. The display band climbs 36 → 44 → 52 → 68, a step of roughly 1.2 that sits close to a Minor Third. It then leaps from 18px straight to 36px, skipping the mid-size headings a conventional Major Third scale would supply. Tracking runs at a uniform -0.03em across every display size, which tightens the grotesk into slabs. The 11px uppercase label at +0.06em and weight 600 is the only place weight climbs, and it does so to make a whisper legible.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Archivo | 600 | 11px | 1.4 | 0.66px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Archivo | 400 | 14px | 1.2 | -0.14px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Archivo | 400 | 15px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Archivo | 400 | 16px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Archivo | 400 | 18px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| heading-sm | Archivo | 400 | 36px | 1.1 | -1.08px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Archivo | 400 | 44px | 1.0 | -1.32px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Archivo | 400 | 52px | 1.0 | -1.56px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Archivo | 400 | 68px | 0.9 | -2.04px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Archivo weight 400 with -0.03em tracking (-2.04px at 68px, -1.08px at 36px). The restraint is the authority, because regular weight at display size reads as a confident document rather than an advert.
- Split section headings into two 36px lines, #1e1e1e then #777777. Tone carries hierarchy so weight does not have to.
- Keep #ee884f to the primary CTA fill and single status dots, with #1e1e1e text on it. This is non-negotiable, because one hue spent at most twice per screen stays legible as "act here".
- Stack surfaces tonally: #fbfbf9 canvas, #f5f2f0 tabs, #f0eae5 panels, #ffffff mockups. Depth comes from 2–4% value steps instead of borders.
- Keep corners at 4px on buttons and 6px on panels. Near-square geometry reads as paper and forms, matching an RFP product's subject matter.
- Use the 11px weight 600 uppercase label with 0.66px tracking for eyebrows and section indexes. It is the only marketing-copy role where weight climbs above 500.
- Hold the 1264px container and 128px between sections. Generous rhythm is what lets regular-weight type hold a 68px headline without looking underpowered.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 600 or 700 for "punch". This breaks the thesis directly: hierarchy lives in size and the ink-to-#777777 handoff, and a 700 headline instantly reads as conventional SaaS.
- Don't use #ee884f as a section background, gradient stop or headline highlight. With two measured uses, scaling it into a field converts a signal into decoration and erases the CTA.
- Don't swap Ink #1e1e1e for pure black #000000 (not a system token). The 12% lift is what keeps black text from vibrating against the warm #fbfbf9 canvas.
- Don't round buttons into 4800px pills or cards to 16px. Full radius belongs only to toggles, avatars and the play button, and soft corners would turn ledger forms into consumer chips.
- Don't put the xl shadow on the #f0eae5 panel itself. Shadows never go on containers, only on the #ffffff mockup that floats inside.
- Don't fill the jump between 18px body-lg and 36px heading-sm with an invented intermediate heading size. The gap is intentional, and mid-sized headings would blur the binary of "reading text" versus "statement".
- Don't promote the consent panel's #1863dc link blue, #008000 status green or 2px radius into product UI. Those are CookieYes vendor values and never system tokens.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fbfbf9 (Paper Canvas)
- panel surface: #f0eae5 (Sand Panel)
- primary text: #1e1e1e (Ink)
- secondary text: #777777 (Pewter Caption)
- inverted text: #f0e9e5 (Cream Ink)
- status accent: #ee884f (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #ee884f (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and progress bars render in Ink #1e1e1e and Pewter Caption #777777 on Sand Panel #f0eae5. Ember Signal #ee884f is permitted only as one solid highlighted bar, point or status dot per visualization, not as a series color.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #ee884f, text #1e1e1e, Archivo 14px weight 500, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing normal, padding 8px 20px, height 40px, border none, border-radius 4px. Apply box-shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0) 0px 5px 2px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.01) 0px 4px 1px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0px 2px 1px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 0px 1px 1px 0px`. Place a secondary sibling 8px to its left with background #1e1e1e, text #f0e9e5, and identical radius, padding and shadow. Do not use white text on the orange button.

2. Build a sticky navigation bar: position sticky top 0, height 88px, background #fbfbf9d9, no border, no shadow, inner container max-width 1264px with 24px horizontal padding. Put the left wordmark in #1e1e1e at 128px wide. Center the links "Product ↓", "Use cases ↓", "Security", "About" and "Blog" in Archivo 15px weight 400, line-height 1.5, #1e1e1e, with 24px gaps. Place two 4px-radius buttons on the right, 8px apart: Ink (#1e1e1e fill, #f0e9e5 text) and Ember (#ee884f fill, #1e1e1e text), both 14px weight 500 with 8px 20px padding.

3. Build a product pillar section. First, a two-tone heading: line one "Knowledge Management" and line two "A self healing, fully governed knowledge base", both Archivo 36px weight 400, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -1.08px, line one #1e1e1e and line two #777777. Right-align a "Learn more →" link in 14px #777777. Leave a 24px gap, then add a panel with background #f0eae5, border-radius 6px 6px 0 0 and padding 24px, containing a centered #ffffff mockup with 6px radius and box-shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 0px 32px 68px 0px`. Add a 15px caption with an ink lead clause and a grey continuation. Below the panel, add four equal tab cells with 1px #fbfbf9 gutters, 24px padding and 15px #1e1e1e text: active #f0eae5, inactive #f5f2f0, hover #e3d7cd. Round the outer bottom corners at 6px.

4. Build the hero: background #fbfbf9, 1264px container, two columns with a 64px gap. The left column holds an eyebrow "AI NATIVE. ENTERPRISE READY." in Archivo 11px weight 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.66px, #1e1e1e. After 20px comes an h1 in Archivo 68px weight 400, line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -2.04px, #1e1e1e, four lines. After a further 24px comes body copy in Archivo 18px weight 400, line-height 1.3, #1e1e1e. The right column holds a dark video frame with background #1e1e1e and 0px radius, vertically centered. Leave 128px below before the logo strip.

## Components

### Ember Button — Primary Action

**Role:** the single conversion action per view

Warm, low, near-square. The spec: background #ee884f, text #1e1e1e, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 8px 20px, height 40px (estimated), Archivo at 14px weight 500, and the four-layer subtle shadow peaking at rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 0 1px 1px. Dark ink on orange instead of the conventional white-on-brand is deliberately anti-convention. It keeps the button inside the ink system and makes orange read as material rather than alarm. Use it once per viewport, top right of the nav and at section conclusions.

### Ink Button — Secondary

**Role:** confident alternative to the primary

Solid, heavy, quiet. The spec: background #1e1e1e, text #f0e9e5, no visible border, border-radius 4px, padding 8px 20px, height 40px (estimated), Archivo at 14px weight 500, and the same subtle four-layer shadow. Where most systems demote secondary actions to an outline, Anchor demotes by hue alone, a full ink slab beside an ember slab. That keeps both buttons equally tappable and lets color, not chrome, rank them. It sits left of the Ember Button in the nav pair.

### Learn More Link — Arrow Text

**Role:** tertiary navigation into product pages

Grey text with an arrow. The spec: transparent background, text #777777, no border, border-radius 0px, padding 0px, Archivo at 14px weight 400 with -0.14px tracking, followed by a 4px gap and a 12px arrow glyph in the same grey. It is right-aligned on the baseline of the two-tone section heading. Because it is the same grey as the heading's second line, it reads as part of the sentence's quiet half rather than as a competing call to action.

### Navigation Bar — Sticky Frosted

**Role:** persistent wayfinding and dual CTA

A translucent paper strip. The spec: background #fbfbf9d9 at 88px height, sticky, no border and no shadow, content constrained to 1264px. The 128px-wide Anchor wordmark sits left in #1e1e1e. Centered links in Archivo 15px weight 400 #1e1e1e at 24px gaps read "Product" and "Use cases", both with down-chevrons, then "Security", "About" and "Blog". On the right, an Ink Button and an Ember Button sit 8px apart. The bar refuses the conventional bottom hairline, so content slides beneath a tone, not a line.

### Hero — Editorial Split

**Role:** thesis statement plus product proof

Two-column, text-led. The left column stacks a small 11px weight 600 uppercase eyebrow ("AI NATIVE. ENTERPRISE READY.") in #1e1e1e with 0.66px tracking, then 20px of space. Below it comes a 68px weight 400 headline at line-height 0.9 and -2.04px tracking in #1e1e1e, then a 24px gap and 18px body copy in #1e1e1e. The right column holds a dark product video frame at 0px radius. Four lines of regular-weight display type stacked tighter than their own size signal authority through density rather than boldness.

### Logo Strip — Trust Row

**Role:** social proof without color

Monochrome, centered, sparse. A centered small label sits above the row: Archivo 11px weight 600, uppercase, 0.66px tracking, #1e1e1e, set as an h2. Below it, six customer logos sit in a single row on #fbfbf9, rendered in ink monochrome at uniform cap height with 64px gaps, with no tiles, borders or radius. Stripping every logo to ink keeps the chromatic budget at one hue even where third-party brands appear. It also mutes the convention of colorful logo walls.

### Two-Tone Section Heading

**Role:** names a product pillar and its promise

The signature move. The spec: two stacked lines of Archivo 36px weight 400, line-height 1.1, -1.08px tracking, with no gap between them. Line one, the pillar name (for example "Knowledge Management"), is #1e1e1e. Line two, the benefit sentence, is #777777. The left edge aligns to the content column, with a Learn More Link right-aligned on the last baseline and a 24px gap above the feature panel. Tone replaces weight here: the eye reads the dark line as label and the grey line as explanation without a single bold glyph.

### Feature Showcase Panel — Sand Card

**Role:** frames a product mockup and caption

Tonal, borderless, wide. The spec: background #f0eae5, border-radius 6px on the top corners, padding 24px, and no border or shadow on the panel itself. It holds a centered #ffffff product mockup carrying the xl shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 0 32px 68px. A 15px caption sits bottom-left: its lead clause is #1e1e1e and its continuation is #777777. The shadow lives on the screenshot, not the container. That inverts the conventional card-with-shadow pattern so the software, not the frame, appears to float.

### Feature Tab Row — Four-Up Selector

**Role:** switches the panel's showcased capability

Flat cells, tonal state. Four equal columns are joined to the panel's bottom edge with 0px 0px 6px 6px corners on the outer pair, separated by 1px gutters of #fbfbf9. Each cell has 24px padding and Archivo 15px weight 400 #1e1e1e copy. The active cell is #f0eae5, continuous with the panel above. Inactive cells are #f5f2f0, and hover is #e3d7cd. Selection is communicated by surface merging rather than an underline or an accent color. That is the tonal-layering philosophy applied to state.

### Section Index — Sticky Sidebar

**Role:** in-page table of contents

Micro-label column. The spec: a left-hand stack of four links ("KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT", "RESPONSE AUTOMATION", "DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE", "COLLABORATION") in Archivo 11px weight 600, uppercase, 0.66px tracking, #777777, with 8px vertical gaps. There is no background, border, bullets or active pill, and the current section shifts to #1e1e1e. It runs parallel to the content column and borrows the broadsheet convention of marginalia over the SaaS convention of sticky tab bars.

### Gradient Product Stage — Decorative Backdrop

**Role:** atmospheric frame for live UI

The system outlier. A full-width block at 0px radius filled with a grainy #9da5c7 periwinkle gradient. It holds a floating #ffffff window with 6px radius and 12px padding, containing file rows on #f5f2f0. A 12px status dot in #ee884f reads "Searching sources", and a grey "Generating…" chip carries 2px radius. The backdrop's color and the green checkmark icons are decorative, not system tokens. They are allowed because they dress product footage rather than interface chrome, and a sage #adc2b2 variant (decorative) alternates in other stages.

### Consent Preferences Panel — Third-Party Outlier

**Role:** legal cookie controls, vendor-supplied

Borrowed chrome, quarantined. The spec: background #ffffff, md shadow rgba(172,171,171,0.3) 0 -1px 10px, padding 16px, and body in Archivo 14px weight 400 with headings 18px weight 700. Its text uses #212121 (vendor value, not a system token, normalized to Ink). Buttons have a 2px #1e1e1e border, 2px radius and 8px padding. Toggles use #d0d5d2 tracks at 50px radius. The vendor's #1863dc link and #008000 "Always Active" label are not system tokens. It breaks the 4px rule because CookieYes ships it.

### Footer — Inverted Ink Block

**Role:** sitemap and legal close

The page's only dark floor. The spec: full-bleed background #1e1e1e, text #f0e9e5, padding 120px 40px 40px, link columns in Archivo 18px weight 400 with 1.3 line-height, and secondary text at 60% Cream Ink (#f0e9e599, derived, not a system token). There is no radius, border or shadow. Inverting to warm ink with cream text instead of conventional cool charcoal with white keeps the paper palette intact even when the page turns dark.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Archivo weight 400 with -0.03em tracking (-2.04px at 68px, -1.08px at 36px). The restraint is the authority, because regular weight at display size reads as a confident document rather than an advert.
- Split section headings into two 36px lines, #1e1e1e then #777777. Tone carries hierarchy so weight does not have to.
- Keep #ee884f to the primary CTA fill and single status dots, with #1e1e1e text on it. This is non-negotiable, because one hue spent at most twice per screen stays legible as "act here".
- Stack surfaces tonally: #fbfbf9 canvas, #f5f2f0 tabs, #f0eae5 panels, #ffffff mockups. Depth comes from 2–4% value steps instead of borders.
- Keep corners at 4px on buttons and 6px on panels. Near-square geometry reads as paper and forms, matching an RFP product's subject matter.
- Use the 11px weight 600 uppercase label with 0.66px tracking for eyebrows and section indexes. It is the only marketing-copy role where weight climbs above 500.
- Hold the 1264px container and 128px between sections. Generous rhythm is what lets regular-weight type hold a 68px headline without looking underpowered.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 600 or 700 for "punch". This breaks the thesis directly: hierarchy lives in size and the ink-to-#777777 handoff, and a 700 headline instantly reads as conventional SaaS.
- Don't use #ee884f as a section background, gradient stop or headline highlight. With two measured uses, scaling it into a field converts a signal into decoration and erases the CTA.
- Don't swap Ink #1e1e1e for pure black #000000 (not a system token). The 12% lift is what keeps black text from vibrating against the warm #fbfbf9 canvas.
- Don't round buttons into 4800px pills or cards to 16px. Full radius belongs only to toggles, avatars and the play button, and soft corners would turn ledger forms into consumer chips.
- Don't put the xl shadow on the #f0eae5 panel itself. Shadows never go on containers, only on the #ffffff mockup that floats inside.
- Don't fill the jump between 18px body-lg and 36px heading-sm with an invented intermediate heading size. The gap is intentional, and mid-sized headings would blur the binary of "reading text" versus "statement".
- Don't promote the consent panel's #1863dc link blue, #008000 status green or 2px radius into product UI. Those are CookieYes vendor values and never system tokens.

## Imagery

The page uses product screenshots and product video, with no lifestyle photography and no illustration. The hero is a dark embedded video frame at 0px radius whose internal orange headline type is mockup-internal, not a system token. Below the hero, real UI renders appear: an RFP answer table, a source-search list and an integration diagram. Each is set on a #ffffff window with 6px radius and lifted by the 0 32px 68px shadow inside a borderless #f0eae5 or #efeeec panel. Icons are small third-party app glyphs (Teams, Google Drive) on white rounded tiles, plus thin-stroke 12px arrows and chevrons in ink. Gradients appear only as grainy periwinkle #9da5c7 and sage #adc2b2 staging washes behind mockups. They are decorative, not system tokens, and never touch type or controls. The narrative is "the software is the artwork": proof over promise.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1264px container centered on a 1920px canvas, with 128px between sections, stretching to 196px around the logo strip. The hero is a two-column split: a narrow text column with a 68px headline on the left, and a wide video frame on the right. Below the 6-column logo row, each product pillar repeats one composition. A sticky section index occupies the left margin, and a wide right column carries the two-tone heading, then a sand panel, then a 4-column tab row. Sections differ by mockup, not by layout, so the rhythm is metronomic. The nav is sticky, frosted #fbfbf9d9, 88px tall, with the logo left, five links centered and two buttons right. The footer is a full-bleed #1e1e1e block with 120px top padding and multi-column links. At 375px, the display drops to the 44px heading size, sections compress to 64px gaps, and the index sidebar collapses. Overall density: spacious.

## Tonal Hierarchy

Anchor ranks information by value, not by weight: 153 of 175 Archivo instances are 400, and the job bold does elsewhere is handed to the drop from #1e1e1e to #777777. It appears in 36px section headings, in 15px panel captions and in the section index. Bolding any heading breaks this, as does introducing a third grey that muddies the binary, or tinting the second line with Ember Signal. To extend the system, add new emphasis as a new tonal split, ink lead then grey continuation, at any type size already in the scale. Reserve weight 600 for the 11px uppercase label, where tracking and caps need the extra stroke to stay legible.

## Ember Rationing

The chromatic budget is one hue with two measured uses: #ee884f fills the primary CTA and lights a single status dot. Everything else, from logos to footer to tab states, is ink, sand or cream. The discipline breaks the moment orange becomes a highlight on headline words, an icon tint, a hover color for tabs, or a chart series. Each of those trains the eye to see orange as decoration, so the CTA stops being findable. To extend the system, express new states through Clay Tab #e3d7cd or the ink-to-grey split. Admit orange only for "act now" or "live process", and keep at most two orange marks per viewport.

## Sand Layering

Depth on Anchor is surface arithmetic: #fbfbf9 canvas, #f5f2f0 tab, #f0eae5 panel, #ffffff mockup and #1e1e1e floor, each step a 2–4% value shift with no borders and no container shadows. Only the floating screenshot earns the heavy 0 32px 68px shadow, and only buttons carry the 6%-peak subtle stack. The system breaks under 1px grey outlines around panels, drop shadows on sand containers, or a cool #ffffff panel competing with mockups. To extend it, place any new container on the next tonal step up from its parent. If no step remains, invert to Ink rather than inventing a new grey.

## Similar Brands

- **Getanchor** — Anthropic: shares a warm off-white canvas, sand-toned panels and a single clay-orange accent, though Anchor sets display type in a grotesk where Anthropic leans on serif and editorial italics.
- **Getanchor** — Mercury: shares regular-weight display headlines with tight negative tracking as the authority signal, but Anchor stays warm-paper where Mercury runs cool and dark.
- **Getanchor** — Notion: shares near-black filled buttons on off-white and a monochrome logo wall, but Anchor stages product UI on tinted gradient backdrops instead of flat illustration.
- **Getanchor** — Granola: shares a cream-and-ink palette, small uppercase eyebrows and screenshot-as-hero storytelling at low chromatic volume.
- **Getanchor** — Loopio: a direct RFP-automation competitor in the same category, with the key difference that Loopio spends saturated brand color across sections while Anchor rations its one hue to the CTA.
